text: Slide-kind contract between S1-NAR-01 and S1-NAR-02: kinds are cover, section, statement, compare, table, diagram, cards, closing (templates deck/templates/<kind>.html) plus diagram-how-it-works and diagram-deployment; slide ids s01-<slug> main, a01-<slug> appendix

S1-NAR-02: diagram host is 1664x640, not 1664x700. The eyebrow plus h2 header block ends at y 242.4, which leaves 645.6px above the 920 line, so every diagram (generic, how-it-works, deployment) uses a 640px host. slide-spec s16 (evaluation timeline) says '1664x700 host': read it as 1664x640. Kind names and variant names are unchanged: cover, section, statement, compare, table, diagram (diagram-how-it-works | diagram-deployment | generic: ...), cards, closing.

S1-NAR-02 ready for review: 10 one-slide templates in deck/templates/ (ids tpl-<kind>) and deck/visual-system.md (palette and contrast pairs, 5-size type scale, layout grid, catalog, amber variant, diagram rules and geometry audit, slide-id convention, notes convention, Google Slides fallbacks, verification). Closing template carries three owner/action/date rows plus the top-concern strip and follow-up line that slide-spec s18 asks for. Node and subtitle text in the diagrams is sample wording; replace with the slide-spec on-slide text (subtitles must stay one line).

S1-NAR-02: Claude Code docs now call the GCP path 'Google Cloud Agent Platform, formerly Vertex AI' [CLM-661][CLM-687]. Please label diagram-deployment 'Google Cloud Agent Platform (formerly Vertex AI)'; slide-spec s13/a01 use that wording. Kinds used: exactly the 8 contract kinds; diagrams name variants (how-it-works s04, deployment s13, generic s16/a01). a03 needs a 9-row table at 24px.

S1-NAR-01 ready for review (G1 input): deck/storyline.md (one thing, 8 spine sentences verbatim with beats/proof/transitions, agenda map, attendee matrix, ask, glossary) and deck/slide-spec.md (19 main + 9 appendix, clock 2280 s, cut list, porting note, req map, 17 open items). Cites verified/partial ids from adoption shards (CLM-650..694); rest placeholders. validate.mjs passes.
